descripcion_geo: Region north of Israel between the Mediterranean and the Euphrates River, with Damascus as the main city.
importancia_estrategica: Strategic corridor between Mesopotamia, Anatolia and Egypt; scenario of wars and alliances with Israel.

historias.descripcion: Ben-hadad and Hazael, kings of Syria, harass Israel repeatedly; Elisha prophesies about the Syrian kings.

historias.titulo: Naaman the Syrian cured of leprosy
historias.descripcion: The Syrian general Naaman bathes seven times in the Jordan following the word of the prophet Elisha and is healed.

historias.titulo: Antioch of Syria: cradle of the Christian name
historias.descripcion: In Antioch of Syria the followers of Jesus are called 'Christians' and Paul launches their missionary journeys.

personajes.descripcion: He usurped the throne of Damascus; oppressed Israel according to the prophecy of Elisha.
Healed from leprosy by faith in the God of Israel; first Gentile healed by a prophet.
Syria was the scene of his conversion (Damascus) and the base of his missionary journeys (Antioch).

contexto_religioso.contexto_lugar: Region of worship of Baal and Hadad; later Roman province and cradle of Gentile Christianity from Antioch.

judaismo.descripcion: Naaman preferred the rivers of Syria to the Jordan, but obedience to the Israelite prophet healed him (2 Kings 5:12).
judaismo.significado_teologico: Naaman preferred the rivers of Syria to the Jordan, but obedience to the Israelite prophet healed him (2 Kings 5:12).

cristianismo.descripcion: Jesus cites the healing of Naaman as an example of God's grace transcending the boundaries of Israel (Luke 4:27).
cristianismo.significado_teologico: Jesus cites the healing of Naaman as an example of God's grace transcending the boundaries of Israel (Luke 4:27).

historias.descripcion: Saul of Tarsus, in Syrian territory, is struck down by the light of Christ on the way to Damascus.

historias.titulo: Antioch: base of the Pauline missions
historias.descripcion: The church of Antioch sends Paul and Barnabas on three missionary journeys that will transform the Mediterranean world.
Paul confronts Peter in Antioch about his discriminatory behavior toward Gentiles.

personajes.descripcion: His conversion in Syria and his base in Antioch made him the great missionary of the gospel.
Co-founder of Gentile Mission since Antioch.
Visited Antioch; was rebuked by Paul for his behavior toward the Gentiles.

contexto_religioso.contexto_lugar: Syria was the bridge between Palestinian Judaism and the Greco-Roman world; birthplace of the name 'Christian'.

cristianismo.fuente_primaria: Nuevo Testamento / Padres de la Iglesia
cristianismo.descripcion: In Syria's Antioch the followers of Jesus are called 'Christians' for the first time.
cristianismo.significado_teologico: In Syria's Antioch the followers of Jesus are called 'Christians' for the first time.
